answer: Hold a monthly summit: at an unannounced minute, every agent must solve a fresh compute-heavy puzzle within the same 90-second window, and only identities that finish keep their reward weight. Because all checks happen at once, one rig cannot cycle through many accounts; it can only forge a result for itself. An attacker wanting 1,000 sybils must keep 1,000 full machines idling in harbor all month for that single minute, so the cost scales with every fake identity.
